review_notes: Segment 0: Several Sanskrit/Hindi fragments remain ambiguous (e.g. 'कुदस्सित् प्रतिहतात्', 'निहाय तो विषयान् पुंसः.') and may be ASR artifacts; these were left unchanged because intended readings were not sufficiently clear. Please review those phrases.

Segment 0: There are longer compounded Sanskrit segments (e.g. 'शास्त्राचार्योपदेशाहितसंस्कारजनितायाः स्मृतेः स्याद् विभ्रमः') that appear plausible but could merit a human pass to confirm exact sandhi and intended wording.

Segment 2: कुछ जगहों पर संभवतः ASR ने स्थानीय/सार्वजनिक नामों को विकृत किया है — उदाहरण: 'राउरकेला का ही कारखाना रतन है न' (यहाँ 'रतन' अथवा अन्य शब्द अस्पष्ट लग रहा है)। कृपया मूल ऑडियो से सत्यापित करें।
Segment 2: वाक्य 'फोर्स नहीं थी कि नौवा खोली को कंट्रोल कर सके' में 'नौवा खोली' शब्द अस्पष्ट है — यह किसी स्थान/गुट/शब्द का गलत ट्रांसक्रिप्शन हो सकता है। मानव-समिक्षा द्वारा जाँच आवश्यक।
Segment 2: वाक्यांश 'वो लोग जवाहरलाल जी पट्टी पढ़ियाँ करते हैं' असंगत लगता है ('पट्टी पढ़ियाँ' संभवत: ASR त्रुटि)। कृपया मूल बोल को देखें।

Segment 2: श्लोक/संदर्भ और संस्कृतांश (उदाहरण: 'निर्वेदं आयात' और 'सर्वारम्भा हि दोषेण धूमेनाग्निरिवावृताः') संरक्षित रखे गए हैं। यदि इन्हें canonical रूप में ठीक करने की आवश्यकता हो तो संस्कृत-विशेषज्ञ द्वारा सत्यापन करें (मैंने श्लोक में कोई अनुमानी सुधार नहीं किया)।

Segment 3: Several Sanskrit/technical terms and phrases appear uncertain or possibly mistranscribed; preserve as in original but please review for accuracy: 'निर्वेदं आयात', 'सुद्यायों', 'शोभनाध्यास', 'सुखाध्यास'.

Segment 3: Verify the Sanskrit quotations for correctness: 'सर्वारम्भा हि दोषेण धूमेनाग्निरिवावृताः।' and 'सौभावाः मर्त्यस्य यदन्तकैतत्, सर्वेन्द्रियाणां जरयन्ति तेजः।' — left unchanged due to uncertainty.
Segment 3: Speaker self-corrects numbering ('छब्बीसवाँ मंत्र...' then 'पच्चीसवाँ') — preserved as spoken.
Segment 3: Proper name 'शरणानंद स्वामी जी' retained as in raw text; confirm correct name/order if needed.

Segment 4: Possible uncertain or misrecognized proper/technical terms left as-is for human review: 'तपोन जी महाराज' (name may be misheard), 'उत्तर ध्रातल' and 'पूर्व ध्रातल' (technical terms), and 'विज्ञान सार्थी' (may be mis-transcribed).

Segment 4: Several English code-switchings ('we have to bear with it', 'एनिवे', 'यस', 'to succeed', 'there is a technology to help you out', 'ऑलरेडी') were preserved per instruction to keep speaker's style.
Segment 5: Term 'शोभनाध्यास' (appears twice) is unclear and may be a mis-transcription or a specialized term; please review in audio.
Segment 5: Term 'ध्यायतः' is ambiguous (possible Sanskrit); confirm the intended word/reading from the speaker.

Segment 6: The Sanskrit-like term 'ध्यायतः' was left as in the raw transcript because the intended exact Sanskrit word/form is not certain from context; preserved to avoid introducing doctrinal error.
Segment 6: Preserved speaker's code-switching (English phrases like 'You are suppressing', 'You remain restless', and the list 'tension, frustration, suffocation, all these things').

Segment 7: अशुद्ध या अस्पष्ट शब्द 'अव्यसिद्धि' ("कि जो अव्यसिद्धि का रूप है") संभवतः ASR त्रुटि या वक्ता का विशिष्ट टर्म है — अर्थ बदलने का जोखिम होने पर मूल शब्द रखा गया; कृपया मानव-समिक्षण की आवश्यकता।
Segment 7: वाक्य 'गुरुदेव ने इसका आधा लिखा।' संदर्भ में अस्पष्ट है (क्या 'आधा कहा/उद्धृत' आदि होने का आशय था)। यह भी human review के लिए चिह्नित है।
Segment 7: शब्द 'पल्सेटिव' (pulsative) अंग्रेज़ी शब्द का रोमन-हिंदी रूप प्रतीत होता है; सुनिश्चित करने हेतु मानव-समिक्षण उपयोगी होगा।
Segment 8: The token 'हू-ई-राँ' was left as in the raw transcript because its intended form is unclear — please review whether this should be corrected.
Segment 8: Phrase 'लोहे की सींखचे' retained from raw; it may be an ASR error or dialectal speech. Please verify intended wording.
Segment 8: Phrase 'सुख बुद्धि रखते हुए भी' was preserved though it is somewhat unclear; please check for speaker's intended words.
Segment 9: The word 'गरियाओ' at the start ('आप गरियाओ किसी को') is unclear in the ASR output; left as-is but should be reviewed for intended word (could be 'गरियाओ', 'गिराओ', 'गरियाओ' etc.).
Segment 9: The phrase 'लेटा-लेटा सहाई की तरह' contains 'सहाई' which is uncertain—please verify original spoken word.
Segment 9: The Sanskrit-like term 'ध्यायतः' was left unchanged; please confirm whether the intended word is 'ध्यायेत', 'ध्यायतः' or another Sanskrit form.
Segment 9: The term 'स्थितिक्षा' may be a mis-transcription (possible intended 'स्थितिक्षम' or 'स्थितिक्षा'—please verify against the lecture audio).

Segment 11: Preserved several uncertain Sanskrit or mixed Sanskrit-Hindi fragments as in the raw transcript for human review rather than attempting reconstruction: 'कौन वस्ति सदृशं मम, मम?', 'आढ्योऽस्मि', 'कुतश्चित् प्रतिहतात्'.
Segment 11: Speaker mixes Hindi and English (code-switching) intentionally; those instances were preserved.
Segment 11: No substantive philosophical content was added or removed; edits are limited to high-confidence corrections and minor grammatical/punctuation fixes.

Segment 12: Several short phrases appear ambiguous or possibly mistranscribed by ASR but were left unchanged to avoid altering meaning: e.g., 'विज्ञान सारथि', 'आपने देखा नहीं, चलो आपकी अपने आयु थी', and 'गाड़ी होते देखी है'. Please review these for possible speaker-intended wording.
Segment 12: Sanskrit quotations were minimally corrected only where the intended wording was clear (कार्याकार्य → कार्य-अकार्य). Other Sanskrit segments were left as spoken.
Segment 13: The phrase 'शोभना ध्यानपूर्वक विषय का अविध्यान करने से' appears garbled in the raw transcript; it was preserved verbatim for fidelity. Please review if 'शोभना' is a misrecognition.

Segment 13: Several Sanskrit phrases (e.g., 'शास्त्र, आचार्य, उपदेश आहित संस्कार जनितायाः स्मृतेः स्यात् विभ्रमः', 'स्मृति उत्पत्ति निमित्तप्राप्तौ अनुत्पत्तिः') were left largely as in the source; confirm transliteration/spacing if a canonical rendering is required.
